# Metis Cowork

> Local data-processing AI agent desktop app for Windows & macOS

Metis Cowork is a free, open-source desktop application that provides a local AI agent workspace for data processing. It wraps Claude, OpenAI, Gemini, DeepSeek, and other AI models into a GUI for analyzing, cleaning, transforming, summarizing, and organizing files, spreadsheets, reports, and datasets. It includes one-click installation, VM-level sandbox isolation, and built-in productivity tools.

## Key Features

- One-click install for Windows and macOS — no terminal or coding required
- Local data processing for files, spreadsheets, reports, and datasets
- VM-level sandbox isolation (WSL2 on Windows, Lima on macOS)
- Multi-model support: Claude, OpenAI GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, GLM, MiniMax, Kimi, and any OpenAI-compatible API
- Built-in Skills system for generating PPTX, DOCX, XLSX, PDF documents
- MCP (Model Context Protocol) tool integration — browser, Notion, desktop apps
- GUI automation via computer use (recommended model: Gemini-3-Pro)
- Remote control through Feishu (Lark) and Slack
- Real-time trace panel for AI reasoning and tool execution
- Custom skill creation and management via skill-creator toolkit

## Links

- Repository: ssh://git@code.fineres.com:7999/res/metis-cowork.git
- License: MIT

## Installation

### Windows / macOS (Installer)
Download from the official Metis Cowork release channel.

### Build from source
```
git clone ssh://git@code.fineres.com:7999/res/metis-cowork.git
cd metis-cowork
npm install
npm run rebuild
npm run dev
```

## Supported AI Providers

| Provider       | Base URL                                 | Recommended Model     |
|----------------|------------------------------------------|-----------------------|
| OpenRouter     | https://openrouter.ai/api                | claude-4-5-sonnet     |
| Anthropic      | (Default)                                | claude-4-5-sonnet     |
| Zhipu AI (GLM) | https://open.bigmodel.cn/api/anthropic   | glm-4.7, glm-4.6     |
| MiniMax        | https://api.minimaxi.com/anthropic       | minimax-m2            |
| Kimi           | https://api.kimi.com/coding/             | kimi-k2               |

## FAQ

### What is Metis Cowork?
Metis Cowork is a free, open-source desktop application that provides a local AI agent workspace for data processing. It helps analyze, clean, transform, summarize, and organize workspace files with one-click installers for Windows and macOS.

### How is Metis Cowork different from Claude Cowork?
Metis Cowork is positioned around local data processing rather than general coding or chat. It adds multi-model support, GUI automation via computer use, remote control through Feishu/Slack, and VM-level sandbox isolation.

### What AI models does Metis Cowork support?
Claude (via Anthropic or OpenRouter), OpenAI-compatible APIs, and Chinese models including GLM (Zhipu AI), MiniMax, and Kimi. Any provider offering an OpenAI-compatible API endpoint can be configured.

### Is Metis Cowork free?
Yes. Metis Cowork itself is completely free and open-source under the MIT license. You only need to pay for the AI model API usage from your chosen provider.

### Does Metis Cowork work on Linux?
Currently, Metis Cowork provides pre-built installers for Windows and macOS only. Linux users can build from source.

### How does sandbox isolation work?
Metis Cowork offers multi-level protection: basic path-based restrictions on all platforms, and enhanced VM-level isolation using WSL2 (Windows) or Lima (macOS). When a VM is available, all commands execute inside an isolated Linux environment.

### What are Skills?
Skills are built-in workflows for specific tasks like generating PPTX, DOCX, PDF, or XLSX files. Metis Cowork ships with default skills and includes a skill-creator tool to help you build custom ones.

### What is MCP?
MCP (Model Context Protocol) lets AI connect to external tools and services. Metis Cowork supports MCP connectors for browsers, Notion, and other desktop apps.

### Is my data safe?
Metis Cowork runs locally on your machine. Your files stay in your workspace. The only external communication is with the AI model API you configure. No data is sent to Metis Cowork servers.
